requirements.title: Unified timeline view
requirements.description: Main dashboard displays chronological timeline of events from all registered domains. Events color-coded by domain. Expandable event cards show payload details.

requirements.title: Per-domain sections
requirements.description: Dashboard includes collapsible sections for each registered domain showing domain-specific summary, recent events, and link to domain's deep-dive UI.

requirements.title: Trend charts
requirements.description: Dashboard includes configurable trend charts with 7d/30d/90d time windows. Line charts for continuous metrics, bar charts for discrete events. Domain comparison overlays.

requirements.title: Mobile-responsive design
requirements.description: Dashboard adapts to phone screens for quick daily checks. Simplified mobile view prioritizes daily brief and critical metrics. Full features on tablet/desktop.
